description: Public transport stops, Accra, Ghana is a data set listed in Transport Data Commons (Transport Data Catalogue), a transport data catalogue, published or maintained by Transformative Urban Mobility Initiative (TUMI). An OpenStreetMap overlay containing the locations and names of all public transport stops in Accra. Coverage: Ghana. The portal files it under the publisher Transformative Urban Mobility Initiative (TUMI). Its tags are city-of-accra, ghana, tumi-data. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEOJSON, URL. The portal shows 2026-08-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-tdc-portal.
